recommendation.reason: T2: no weak dimension, Real and Solid strong, Difficult strong; only 20 public tasks is an adoption risk.
risks: Only 20 of 50 tasks are public; 30 private.
Reward hacking and shortcuts are not addressed.
Only aggregate scores are public; no task-level results or model trajectories.
